jobOpening.description:
Eastdil Secured advises clients on commercial real estate sales, financings and capital raising. Analysts in London join deal teams straight away and help run transactions from first pitch to closing.

What you'll do

  • Build cash-flow models and valuation analyses for real estate assets
  • Prepare marketing materials and investor presentations
  • Research markets, tenants and comparable transactions

What we're looking for

  • Graduating in 2027 with a strong academic record in any subject

  • Excellent Excel skills and attention to detail

  • Interest in real estate and capital markets
